description: Work with vector masks (Layer > Vector Mask): make one from a path (Current Path), disable or enable it, or delete it. Rasterize a vector mask with rasterize_layers

path.description: create_from_path: the path's name in the Paths panel. Default the selected path or work path

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)
